decisions.reason: The IMU module sits squarely within the firm's modular sensor platform, so its own hardware, firmware and API expertise lets it interpret results and keep refining the module at low cost.
The four-channel solid state relay is a close extension of the firm's existing relay and control peripherals, so the firm fully understands it and can maintain it with little extra effort.
The kit bundles sensors and software the firm knows well, but kits are easier to consolidate during a platform shift to newer connectors, so the drop risk is moderate.
The RGB LED control module builds on the firm's established LED and control know-how and is still too new to judge, so keeping it while learning from early results fits its absorptive capacity.
The wallbox remote access service supports the strategic expansion of charging and energy management and builds on the firm's software and networking competence, making it a core growth offering.
